dedupe_keys.name: gridded 5 arcmin farm size specific and crop specific harvested areas in 56 countries

description: This dataset maps where small and large farms are and which crops they grow, as harvested area grids at 5 arc-minutes that are both farm-size-specific and crop-specific, for 56 countries. The Zenodo record says there are over 608 million farms worldwide that differ greatly, that the maps were checked for reliability for country and global studies, and that they are meant to measure how agricultural policy, water availability and climate change affect small and large farms differently. Version 1.03.1 was published on 2 March 2023 by Han Su, Barbara Willaarts, Diana Luna Gonzalez, Maarten Krol and Rick Hogeboom as a dataset archive of about 755 MB and a code and source data archive of about 1.1 GB, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is 56 countries; the list is not stated on the page read. Caveats: farm-size classes come from census data of different years, and grids are modelled allocations. For simulation it lets hazard and water shortage scenarios separate impacts on smallholders from large farms, and weights food supply exposure by farm type. Related catalogue records include the CLIMADA crop production exposure data and the Unified Cropland Layer.
